description: This file contains helper functions and type definitions for managing and processing data related to the Mattermost integration within the openclaw project, including model name extraction, agent ID normalization, session key resolution, and message mention normalization.

methods.name: extractShortModelName
methods.description: Extracts a simplified model name from a full model string by removing version suffixes.

methods.name: resolveIdentityName
methods.description: Resolves the identity name for a given agent ID from the configuration.

methods.name: resolveThreadSessionKeys
methods.description: Generates session keys for thread management, wrapping shared logic with custom thread ID normalization.

methods.name: normalizeMention
methods.description: Removes bot mentions from message text while preserving formatting and structure.
